rootCause: SDK automatic refresh calls setting.update for both menus. Core update renders the root panel; the open quality/audio panel loses art-current before the click. Restore the owned panel only after both automatic updates, guarded by SDK identity, update revision and ownership. Explicit update is unchanged.

originalFailure.observation: Settings remain shown; active quality selector is replaced by root settings panel. Controlled real-SDK refresh reproduces the same navigation reset on all four tested core/SDK pairs.
